command_line:
set -eu
cat > fit_aic.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
input_path <- args[[1]]
output_path <- args[[2]]

d <- read.delim(input_path, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE,
                stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = c("", "NA"))
required <- c("Efficacy", "BMI")
missing_cols <- setdiff(required, names(d))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(paste("Missing required columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
}

efficacy <- trimws(as.character(d[["Efficacy"]]))
bmi <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d[["BMI"]]))
keep <- !is.na(efficacy) & efficacy != "" & !is.na(bmi)
fitdata <- data.frame(PR = as.integer(efficacy[keep] == "PR"), BMI = bmi[keep])
if (nrow(fitdata) == 0) stop("No complete Efficacy/BMI rows available")
if (length(unique(fitdata$PR)) < 2) stop("Binary response has fewer than two classes")

fit <- glm(PR ~ BMI, data = fitdata, family = binomial())
result <- data.frame(
  metric = c("AIC", "n", "event_PR", "non_event", "formula", "family"),
  value = c(format(AIC(fit), digits = 17),
            as.character(nrow(fitdata)),
            as.character(sum(fitdata$PR == 1)),
            as.character(sum(fitdata$PR == 0)),
            "PR_vs_nonPR ~ BMI",
            "binomial_logit"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.table(result, file = output_path, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
RSCRIPT
